summary: Similarweb Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held May 28, 2026, where shareholders approved all proposals. Additionally, the filing disclosed that Mr. Harel Beit-On stepped down as Chair and member of the Audit Committee, effective at the meeting's conclusion, and Mr. Joe Del Preto was appointed as new Chair, with Mr. Kipp Bodnar joining the committee. The changes were prompted by prior announcement in the May 14th 6-K. This represents a management/board change event, not a routine meeting notice. The filing also incorporates these results into its registration statements, with no special-situation financial terms.
